data.name: Musahib
data.gender_notes: Musahib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'sahaba' meaning 'to accompany, to be present with'. In Islamic history, the term 'sahabi' refers to those who met and interacted with the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) personally. The name Musahib, derived from this root, symbolizes the desire for good companionship and strong relationships. The name Musahib carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musahib usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies companionship with the righteous and the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)
data.etymology: Musahib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musahib total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مصاحب
in_arabic.meaning: صاحب أو رفيق للنبي أو للشخصيات الهامة في الإسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: مصاحب هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ص-ح-ب' والذي يعني الصحبة أو الرفقة. في السياق الإسلامي، يُستخدم المصطلح لوصف الأشخاص الذين كانوا رفقاء للنبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم أو للشخصيات الهامة في التاريخ الإسلامي. يُعتبر اسم مصاحب من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى القرب والصداقة مع الشخصيات النبوية أو التاريخية المهمة.

in_urdu.name: مصاحب
in_urdu.meaning: نبی کے ساتھی یا اہم شخصیات کے رفیق
in_urdu.long_meaning: مصاحب ایک عربی نام ہے جو جذر 'ص-ح-ب' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے صحت یا رفاقت۔ اسلامی سیاق و سباق میں، یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے ساتھی یا تاریخی شخصیات کے رفیق تھے۔ یہ نام قرب اور دوستی کے معنی رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر نبوی یا تاریخی اہم شخصیات کے ساتھ۔

in_hindi.name: मुसाहिब
in_hindi.meaning: नबी के साथी या महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्तियों के साथी
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुसाहिब एक अरबी नाम है जो 'ص-ح-ب' जड़ से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है साथी या मित्रता। इस्लामी संदर्भ में, यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो पैगंबर मुहम्मद सल्लल्लahu अलैहि वसल्लम के साथी या ऐतिहासिक शख्सियतों के साथी थे। यह नाम करीबी और मित्रता के अर्थ को धारण करता है, खासकर पैगंबर या ऐतिहासिक महत्वपूर्ण शख्सियतों के साथ।

in_english.name: Musahib

in_english.long_meaning: Musahib is an Arabic name derived from the root 'ص-ح-ب', meaning companion or fellowship. The name Musahib signifies closeness and friendship, particularly with prophetic or historically significant personalities. It reflects a sense of spiritual camaraderie and loyalty.

These companions embodied the ideals of loyalty, commitment, and selflessness, and their examples continue to inspire Muslims today. The name Musahib, therefore, evokes a sense of pride in one's Islamic heritage and an aspiration to emulate the noble qualities of the Prophet's companions.

In contrast, bad companionship can lead one astray and even put one's faith at risk. The name Musahib, therefore, serves as a reminder to seek out good companions and to cultivate strong relationships based on mutual respect, trust, and shared Islamic values. It is a call to build a community of believers who uplift and support one another, and to model the companionship that existed between the Prophet and his closest followers.
